description: This file defines an interface and an abstract class for implementing object pooling in C#. The interface IObjectPool<T> provides methods for allocating and freeing pooled objects. The abstract class PooledResource<T> supports pooled objects with pool tracking and disposal logic.

classes.name: PooledResource<T>
classes.description: Abstract class providing pooled object behavior, including pool tracking and disposal logic.

methods.name: Allocate
methods.description: Method to allocate a pooled resource. Defined in IObjectPool<T>.

methods.name: Free
methods.description: Method to return a resource to the pool. Defined in IObjectPool<T>.

methods.name: SignalPurge
methods.description: Virtual method to handle purging of the resource, default implementation calls Dispose.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Implements IDisposable; returns the resource to its pool if set.

methods.name: OnResetState
methods.description: Allows the resource to reset its state when recycled or purged.
